eventMetadata.context_description: In the Western Conference first-round NBA playoffs, the Minnesota Timberwolves hold a 3-2 series lead over the Denver Nuggets heading into critical Game 6 at home, with trader sentiment shaped by severe Timberwolves injuries that have fueled Denver's recent surge. Anthony Edwards remains sidelined with a knee bone bruise expected to sideline him for weeks, Donte DiVincenzo is out for the season with a torn Achilles from Game 4, and key reserve Ayo Dosunmu—who erupted for 43 points in that contest—was ruled out Friday with a calf strain. Nuggets forward Aaron Gordon is questionable with left calf tightness after missing recent games, while Peyton Watson nurses a hamstring issue; Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray have anchored Denver's three straight wins amid Minnesota's depleted rotation. Home-court advantage and Rudy Gobert's rim protection offer Wolves upside, but the Nuggets' healthier core and altitude return in a potential Game 7 tilt the implied probabilities.

eventMetadata.context_description: The New York Knicks hold a 3-2 series lead over the Atlanta Hawks in their Eastern Conference first-round playoff matchup, with Game 6 looming Wednesday at State Farm Arena as an elimination contest for Atlanta. Critical latest injury report lists Knicks star Jalen Brunson out with ankle soreness—after his 39-point Game 5 explosion that nabbed a 126-97 road win—plus Miles McBride (groin) and Ariel Hukporti (knee) sidelined, while Josh Hart is questionable (lower back contusion). Hawks remain without Jock Landale (ankle sprain) for the playoffs. New York's defensive versatility from Mikal Bridges and OG Anunoby, paired with Karl-Anthony Towns' scoring, has produced three double-digit victories, though Atlanta's home desperation and Game 2 buzzer-beater rally highlight upset potential in this closely contested series.

eventMetadata.context_description: France holds a slim edge in trader consensus for the 2026 FIFA World Cup winner at 16.4% implied probability, buoyed by a balanced squad at peak ages including Kylian Mbappé and recent qualifier dominance, but a wave of late-April injuries to stars like Mbappé, Spain's Lamine Yamal (hamstring concern, expected fit), Brazil's Rodrygo (out long-term), and others has fueled volatility and kept the top cluster tight. Spain (15.3%) boasts Europe's youngest, deepest pipeline via La Masia, yet group draw challenges temper enthusiasm; England (11.1%) leverages statistical talent peaks despite knockout history; while defending champions Argentina and Brazil (both 8.6%) face aging cores and tough brackets in the expanded 48-team format, amplifying upset potential across a crowded elite field.

Philadelphia rides momentum from two straight blowouts, but Boston's playoff pedigree against the Sixers—winning the last six series—shapes trader consensus amid this rivalry's volatility, recent form, and key matchups like Embiid versus Boston's frontcourt.

title: Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly Election Winner
description:
Legislative Assembly elections are to be scheduled to be held in Tamil Nadu, India, in March–May 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party that wins the greatest number of seats in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly in the 2026 election.

If the results are not known definitively by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

In the event of a tie between multiple parties for the most seats won, this market will resolve in favor of the party that received a greater number of valid votes statewide. If that also results in a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the party whose listed abbreviation appears first in alphabetical order.

This market’s resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named party in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly.

This market will resolve based on the results of this election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results reported by the Indian government, specifically the Election Commission of India (ECI) (https://eci.gov.in). If multiple official reports differ, this market will resolve based on the one that includes the greatest number of Assembly Constituencies (ACs).

eventMetadata.context_description: Incumbent DMK holds commanding trader consensus at 84.5% to emerge as the largest party in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly following the April 23, 2026, single-phase election across 234 constituencies, with vote counting scheduled for May 4. High voter turnout exceeding 83% reflected intense competition, yet DMK's welfare schemes, intact Secular Progressive Alliance including INC and left parties, and pro-incumbency under Chief Minister M.K. Stalin bolster its path to majority government. AIADMK's NDA coalition trails at 8.3% amid leadership splits, while Vijay's debut TVK garners 8.2% on star power but faces untested organizational hurdles; mixed exit polls like Today's Chanakya favor DMK retention, outweighing TVK surges in others.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 24 - May 1, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 24 12:00 PM ET to May 1, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

title: Counter-Strike: FaZe vs FURIA (BO3) - BLAST Rivals Group B
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Lower bracket semifinal match between FaZe and FURIA in the BLAST Rivals Group B, initially scheduled for April 30 at 4:00PM ET.

This market will resolve to "FaZe" if FaZe win the match against FURIA.

This market will resolve to "FURIA" if FURIA win the match against FaZe.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran peace talks, mediated by Pakistan in Islamabad, have stalled after initial mid-April rounds failed to produce a permanent agreement, despite a fragile two-week ceasefire extension agreed on April 8 amid heightened military tensions and a US naval blockade of Iranian ports squeezing oil exports. Recent developments include Iran's April 27 proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and postpone nuclear negotiations, which President Trump dismissed as insufficient, alongside escalating rhetoric and Germany's foreign minister accusing Tehran of stalling tactics. Key sticking points—nuclear enrichment limits, ballistic missile curbs, sanctions relief, and regional proxies like Lebanon—underscore deep divides, with traders pricing slim odds for a deal explicitly ending hostilities due to historical negotiation impasses and no confirmed next round. Upcoming diplomatic efforts remain uncertain as the indefinite truce holds tenuously.

title: Oilers vs. Ducks
description:

eventMetadata.context_description: In the first-round 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs series, the Anaheim Ducks eliminated the Edmonton Oilers with a 5-2 Game 6 victory on April 30, securing a 4-2 series win and advancing despite being underdogs entering the matchup. Oilers trader sentiment soured amid a mounting injury crisis, with captain Connor McDavid limited by an ankle issue, Leon Draisaitl returning from lower-body woes but not at full strength, Zach Hyman and Jason Dickinson as game-time decisions, and absences like Adam Henrique and Mattias Janmark exposing depth vulnerabilities. Ducks leveraged home-ice edge in Games 2, 4, and 6, strong goaltending from Lukas Dostal, and timely scoring, overcoming their own losses like Radko Gudas to capitalize on Edmonton's woes in a resilient upset.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen lead Polymarket's Eurovision 2026 winner odds at 34.2% implied probability with their violin-pop fusion "Liekinheitin," a UMK standout blending classical flair and catchy hooks that's dominated bookmakers, fan polls, and OGAE votes since its February selection, signaling broad jury and televote appeal. Greece's Akylas follows at 16.6% on the high-energy "Ferto," a Sing for Greece televote magnet with dance-pop punch, while Denmark's Søren Torpegaard sits at 12.6% via a polished ballad evoking Nordic jury favorites like past winners. France (8.2%), Australia (6.2%), and surging Israel (5.1%) round out contenders amid pre-party buzz boosting Romania and Israel, but first rehearsals this week—pivotal for staging and live delivery—could reshape this wide-open field ahead of Vienna semis on May 12/14 and final on May 16.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus crowns California Gov. Gavin Newsom as the frontrunner for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, reflecting his executive experience managing the nation's largest state economy, robust national fundraising, and consistent anti-Trump posture positioning him as a party standard-bearer in a post-2024 open field. Georgia Sen. Jon Ossoff surged into contention last week after a viral speech blasting the "Mar-a-Lago mafia," but odds cooled following his public denial of presidential ambitions. Former VP Kamala Harris's probabilities quadrupled recently after her April signals of interest in another White House bid, though 2024 baggage tempers enthusiasm. AOC energizes progressives with youth appeal. Support could consolidate via 2026 midterm results, swing-state viability, and early donor endorsements.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by end of April?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and April 30, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for April 30, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket assigns a 99.9% implied probability to "No" for Strait of Hormuz traffic normalizing by April 30, reflecting skin-in-the-game conviction amid the US-Iran conflict's dual blockade—US naval restrictions on Iranian ports since April 13 and Tehran's shipping curbs—which reduced daily transits from ~100 vessels to a trickle of 5-9 amid ship seizures and attacks through late April. Brent crude surged above $120 per barrel, amplifying global energy supply risks and underscoring the chokepoint's role in 20% of seaborne oil trade. While Pentagon estimates suggest six months for full clearance, tail risks include an improbable ceasefire breakthrough or multilateral coalition enabling rapid resumption, though no such developments materialized by month-end.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their June meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

eventMetadata.context_description: Polymarket traders overwhelmingly price a 95.5% implied probability of no Federal Reserve rate change at the June 16-17 FOMC meeting, reflecting the central bank's April 29 decision to hold the federal funds rate steady at 3.50%-3.75% amid hotter-than-expected March 2026 CPI data showing 3.3% year-over-year inflation—the highest since May 2024—driven by surging energy costs from geopolitical tensions. Chair Powell affirmed the current monetary policy stance as appropriate to combat persistent inflation pressures while supporting maximum employment, aligning with CME FedWatch futures implying minimal near-term adjustment. This strong consensus could face challenges from softer-than-forecast April CPI on May 12 or weakening nonfarm payrolls, potentially reviving rate-cut odds if disinflation resumes.

title: Trump announces end of military operations against Iran by ...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the military publicly and officially announce that their military operations against Iran, initiated on February 28, 2026, have concluded by the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Qualifying statements must clearly indicate that the operation has ended. Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources or leaks will not qualify. 

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g. posts from his personal Truth Social account), will count. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: The 60-day War Powers Resolution deadline arrives today for U.S. military operations against Iran, initiated February 28 under Operation Epic Fury with joint U.S.-Israel airstrikes targeting missile, nuclear, and military sites. President Trump notified Congress on March 2, but the administration argues the early April ceasefire—extended indefinitely after an initial two-week truce brokered via Pakistan—effectively terminates hostilities, pausing the clock despite an ongoing naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's reported reconstitution of drone and missile capabilities. No official announcement of concluded operations has occurred, amid stalled diplomatic negotiations and yesterday's Senate Republican blockade of halt resolutions; Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth briefed Congress as escalation risks loom if talks fail.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices Robert F. Kennedy Jr. at 49% implied probability to secure the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, propelled by his HHS Secretary role and surging popularity from Make America Healthy Again reforms targeting food and pharmaceutical regulations, which recent polls show resonating strongly with the GOP base. Vice President J.D. Vance holds 38.6% amid record-low approval ratings tied to perceived missteps in Iran negotiations, despite a new book signaling ambitions and leading CPAC's late-March straw poll at 53%. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stands at 21.1%, elevated by diplomatic gains in the ongoing Iran conflict and shadow donor "draft" efforts. President Trump's term limits open a contested primary, with 2026 midterm primaries poised to test cabinet contenders' viability.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 28 - May 5, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 28 12:00 PM ET to May 5, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

The tight clustering of top outcomes—160-179 at 20.1%, 180-199 at 19.1%, and 140-159 at 17.1%—captures uncertainty in his variable rhythm, amplified by recent replies on AI breakthroughs like Full Self-Driving, political hoaxes, and memes. Differentiators include potential spikes from Tesla updates or SpaceX news versus quieter midweek lulls, with May 2-5 activity pivotal to breaking the deadlock in this high-engagement celebrity posting market.

title: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in May 2026?
description: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in May 2026?

markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $150 in May?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation during May 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "High" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". 

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours. 

Per CME contract specifications for WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, a contract’s last trading day is three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day).

The active month changes at the start of the second trading session prior to the nearest listed contract’s last trading session. At that point, the next listed contract becomes the active month (i.e., for the final three trading sessions of the nearest listed contract, the contract for the next month is the active month). The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 6:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date.

For example, if the 25th of the month is a Saturday, the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Tuesday the 21st, and the next listed contract becomes the active month at the start of the trading session for Friday the 17th (6:00 PM ET on Thursday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures contract by CME Group may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the Active Month WTI Crude Oil futures "High" prices available at https://pythdata.app/explore?search=WTI, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles. Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil futures have surged above $105 per barrel amid escalating US-Iran tensions and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint handling 20% of global supply, injecting a substantial geopolitical risk premium into prices. Backwardation in the futures curve signals tight near-term supply expectations, reinforced by constrained OPEC+ output hikes—announced at 206,000 barrels per day for May but limited by conflict—despite US crude inventories at 459.5 million barrels, 1% above the five-year average. EIA's Short-Term Energy Outlook projects Brent peaking at $115/b in 2Q26 on persistent stock tightness. Traders eye weekly EIA reports, the OPEC+ May meeting, and summer demand for volatility, with resolution hinging on de-escalation or further blockades.

title: Presidential Election Winner 2028
description:
The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

title: Which company has the best AI model end of May?
description:
This market will resolve according to the company that owns the model that has the highest arena rank based on the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard (https://lmarena.ai/) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab is checked on May 31, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Overall" Leaderboard tab at https://lmarena.ai/leaderboard/text with style control off will be used to resolve this market.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “xAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking system.

The resolution source for this market is the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard found at https://lmarena.ai/. If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve based on another resolution source.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Overall" Leaderboard tab at https://lmarena.ai/leaderboard/text with style control off will be used to resolve this market.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “xAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking system.

The resolution source for this market is the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard found at https://lmarena.ai/. If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve based on another resolution source.

title: Counter-Strike: Natus Vincere vs GamerLegion (BO3) - BLAST Rivals Group B
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Upper bracket final match between Natus Vincere and GamerLegion in the BLAST Rivals Group B, initially scheduled for April 30 at 6:30PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Natus Vincere" if Natus Vincere win the match against GamerLegion.

This market will resolve to "GamerLegion" if GamerLegion win the match against Natus Vincere.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Natus Vincere enters as clear trader favorites against GamerLegion in BLAST Rivals Spring 2026 Group B's upper bracket final BO3, backed by their #2 HLTV ranking and recent 2-0 domination of FaZe on Anubis and Ancient, where w0nderful posted strong multi-kills. NaVi's stable roster featuring makazze's rifling edge and Aleksib's IGL contrasts GL's recent changes like ash's departure; map veto favors NaVi's Ancient pick, with winner advancing to playoffs semis and loser to quarters amid double-elim pressure.

title: Kharg Island no longer under Iranian control by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Kharg Island is no longer under Iranian control by March 31, 2026 11:59PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

“No longer under the control of Iran” means that Iran no longer exercises primary governmental or military control over Kharg Island, and another state, occupying force, or internationally backed authority has established control over the island.

Temporary raids, isolated landings, special operations, bombardment, sabotage, naval presence offshore, or temporary disruption of Iranian activity will not qualify on their own.

An announcement, threat, or claim that Iran has lost control will not qualify without actual control being established.

If control changes pursuant to a negotiated settlement, ceasefire term, surrender, or transfer agreement, this will qualify only once actual control has been established on the island.

If control over Kharg Island is contested, unclear, disputed, or not sufficiently established by the resolution date, this will not qualify, and the market will resolve to “No”.

The primary resolution source will be official statements from the relevant governments and militaries, along with a consensus of credible reporting.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Kharg Island is no longer under Iranian control by April 15, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

“No longer under the control of Iran” means that Iran no longer exercises primary governmental or military control over Kharg Island, and another state, occupying force, or internationally backed authority has established control over the island.

Temporary raids, isolated landings, special operations, bombardment, sabotage, naval presence offshore, or temporary disruption of Iranian activity will not qualify on their own.

An announcement, threat, or claim that Iran has lost control will not qualify without actual control being established.

If control changes pursuant to a negotiated settlement, ceasefire term, surrender, or transfer agreement, this will qualify only once actual control has been established on the island.

If control over Kharg Island is contested, unclear, disputed, or not sufficiently established by the resolution date, this will not qualify, and the market will resolve to “No”.

The primary resolution source will be official statements from the relevant governments and militaries, along with a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: US airstrikes on military targets at Kharg Island, Iran's primary oil export terminal handling 90% of crude shipments, alongside a tightening naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, have escalated economic pressure on Tehran without displacing Iranian sovereignty, as April 7 attacks spared infrastructure per official reports. Storage tanks are nearing capacity, signaling potential production shutdowns and IMF-projected negative growth for 2026. Stalled US-Iran diplomacy, Trump's maximum pressure campaign, and threats of further escalation—including hypersonic strikes or island seizure—keep tensions high, with no ground operations reported as of May 1. Resolution hinges on verifiable loss of control before the deadline, amid regime defiance and global energy market volatility.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices Rassemblement National leader Jordan Bardella slightly ahead of former Prime Minister Édouard Philippe at 22.5% and 21.5% for the 2027 presidential first round, capturing a fragmented field one year out from the April vote. Recent March municipal elections disappointed RN hopes for major city gains, curbing far-right momentum while Philippe's strong Le Havre mayoral reelection propelled his surge in April polls, where he trails Bardella's 34-42% first-round lead but prevails in most runoffs (e.g., 51.5-48.5% per Elabe). A late-April barometer showed Philippe dipping amid right-wing fatigue, with left figures like Jean-Luc Mélenchon stuck at 8-15%. Party primaries, candidate declarations, or economic shocks could widen the gap in this tight race.

title: LoL: SK Gaming vs Galions (BO3) - Esports World Cup EMEA Qualifier Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the LoL Lower bracket round 1 match between SK Gaming and Galions in the Esports World Cup EMEA Qualifier Playoffs, initially scheduled for April 30 at 11:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "SK Gaming" if SK Gaming win the match against Galions.

This market will resolve to "Galions" if Galions win the match against SK Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 2: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 2. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both SK Gaming and Galions each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 2. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 2.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 2 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 2 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain Baron Nashor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 2 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both SK Gaming and Galions each destroy at least one enemy inhibitor during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) do not destroy any enemy inhibitors.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams destroyed at least one inhibitor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

markets.question: Game 1: Any Player Quadra Kill?
markets.description:
This market is about whether any player achieves a Quadra Kill during Game 1. In League of Legends, a Quadra Kill occurs when a single player kills 4 enemy champions in rapid succession.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player on either team achieves a Quadra Kill during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if no player achieves a Quadra Kill. A Penta Kill (5 kills in rapid succession) also counts as a Quadra Kill having occurred for the purposes of this market.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether a Quadra Kill occurred prior to stoppage. If no Quadra Kill occurred, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

markets.question: Game 1: Odd/Even Total Kills?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Odd" if the total combined kills by both teams in Game 1 is an odd number.

This market will resolve to "Even" if the total combined kills by both teams in Game 1 is an even number.

"Total combined kills" includes all champion kills recorded during the match by both SK Gaming and Galions. Executions (deaths to non-champion sources such as turrets, minions, or neutral monsters where no enemy champion receives kill credit) do not count as kills for the purposes of this market.

If no kills are recorded in Game 1, or if Game 1 is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Galions delivered a stunning 2-0 upset over LEC side SK Gaming in the Esports World Cup 2026 EMEA Qualifier lower bracket round 1 BO3 series on April 30, highlighted by a perfect game 1 where they scored 21 kills to SK's zero amid a 10k gold lead in game 2 from a single role dominance. SK, fresh off a 2-0 win over Team Heretics but hampered by a recent form dip to 55% winrate and midlaner SlowQ substituting for Lider, entered with a strong 12-2 map record in qualifiers yet crumbled against the EMEA Masters Winter runners-up from LFL. Galions advances to face Shifters, while SK's elimination underscores tier 2 teams' upset potential in the double-elimination bracket vying for EWC spots.

title: US x Iran diplomatic meeting by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count. 

The meeting must be in-person and must be publicly acknowledged by either government or reported by a consensus of credible media. Remote meetings, phone calls, or other meetings where the relevant parties are not present will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Ongoing US-Iran diplomatic stalemate, marked by a US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's partial closure in response to earlier strikes, has driven trader consensus toward later resolution dates amid failed mediation attempts. In the past week, planned direct talks in Islamabad via Pakistani intermediaries collapsed, with Iran's Foreign Minister visiting without US counterparts and Tehran denying any scheduled meetings, while President Trump rejected Tehran's latest proposal to reopen the strait while deferring nuclear curbs. Iran's top diplomat blamed Washington during a Russia visit, signaling hardened positions. No new rounds are confirmed, though indirect channels via Oman or Qatar persist; oil price surges reflect escalation risks ahead of any potential summit.
